indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX expense_account_cash_authority ON public.finance_treasury_account_authorities USING btree (user_id, cash_location_id) WHERE (cash_location_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: finance_treasury_account_authorities_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX finance_treasury_account_authorities_pkey ON public.finance_treasury_account_authorities USING btree (id)

triggers.name: expense_history_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER expense_history_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.finance_treasury_account_authorities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION expense_immutable()

triggers.name: expense_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER expense_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.finance_treasury_account_authorities FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION expense_immutable()
